capabilities: Render a checklist from notes in a routines folder inside a daily note code block
Log completion dates into each habit note's frontmatter entries property
Sync habit subtasks with their parent checkbox
Navigate to the previous and next day's notes from the checklist
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Habit Checklist is a companion to the Habit Tracker 21 plugin. Both read and write the same entries list
problem: Obsidian has no built-in habit tracking, so keeping a per-day checklist and a completion history across daily notes takes manual work.

relations.evidence: Habit Checklist is a companion to the Habit Tracker 21 plugin.
using the date format from the Daily notes or Periodic Notes plugin

requires.name: Habit Tracker 21 (optional companion) / Periodic Notes (optional, for date format)

summary: Renders a habit checklist in your daily note from a folder of routine notes, logging each completion date into that note's frontmatter.
